doc: Finds a free slot: first scans D_80073740[0..D_80073734[0]-1] via func_8005EB78() for an entry that reports "done" (0); if none is free, falls back to scanning D_80085458[] for a slot whose f1a field is 0. If a free slot is found (by either scan), dispatches it via func_8005BBFC() with the found index plus this function's own 6 (s16) parameters forwarded unchanged, and returns its (s16) result; otherwise returns -1. Sets/clears the D_80085F98 busy flag around the whole operation.

globals.name: D_80073734
globals.decl: extern s32 D_80073734[4]; /* index 0 = active-entry count; established elsewhere, matches sibling convention (plain s32 array, not a struct) */

globals.name: D_80085458
globals.decl: typedef struct S_80085458 { /* 0x00 */ u8 pad00[0x1A]; /* 0x1A */ u16 f1a; /* 0x1C */ u8 pad1c[0x78-0x1C]; } S_80085458; extern S_80085458 D_80085458[64]; /* stride 0x78 (120) bytes; this function only reads f1a (u16 @0x1A) as a free-slot marker (==0 means free) */

globals.name: D_80085F98
globals.decl: extern s32 D_80085F98[4]; /* mode/busy flag; index 0 set to 1 on entry, cleared to 0 before return */

calls: func_8005EB78(s32 a0) -> s32: dispatch-state query on a D_80073740 flags value; 0 means "free/done".

func_8005BBFC(s16 idx, s16 a0, s16 a1, s16 a2, s16 a3, s16 a4, s16 a5, s16 a6) -> s16: allocates/dispatches the found slot idx with the caller's 6 original (s16) parameters forwarded positionally; still an INCLUDE_ASM stub in src/code.c so only the call's arg setup needed to match.
